name: matchIdentities

versions.rationale: Identity matching for #20, in a fixed order: declared lineage, then file and name, then content hash, then syntax-tree similarity. Anything with more than one candidate is queued. Without declarations it agrees with the hand-recorded store on commits 9cda7f2, a5da380 and 98015d7.

docs: Matches an earlier snapshot's tracked units to the units in the code now.
